chunks: Can He who has created not know (His creation)? He is all-penetrating, all-aware.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is Al-Latif Al-Khabir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm God's omniscience not just as an abstract attribute but as the foundation of divine wisdom in creation, particularly highlighting how His subtlety (Al-Latif) manifests in the intricate details of the universe. It serves as a rhetorical challenge to those who deny resurrection, implying that the One who knows the hidden mechanisms of creation is fully capable of reassembling them. This connection between divine knowledge and creative power reinforces the concept of *Tawhid* in attributes, where God's knowledge is inseparable from His essence.
